tournament.name: Hunter Burton Memorial - HBMO24 - Dave & Adams 2k

decks.notes: The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Grief, then bring them back into play with Reanimate and Animate Dead. The strategy revolves around cheating expensive creatures into play early, overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats. The deck also includes disruption in the form of counterspells like Force of Will and cheap creature removal with cards like Orcish Bowmasters. The goal is to quickly assemble a lethal board state and win the game before the opponent has a chance to respond effectively.

The main focus of this Grixis Aggro deck is to quickly deploy aggressive creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. Utilizing efficient cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for threats and answers, this deck aims to apply pressure while maintaining control over the game. The inclusion of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and disruption cards like Stifle and Wasteland further solidify this deck's strategy of tempo-based aggression and disruption in Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this Grixis Aggro deck is to utilize low-cost, efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Daze, Force of Will, and Lightning Bolt to control the opponent's board and protect its own threats. With a mana base that includes fetch lands and dual lands, the deck aims to maintain consistency and flexibility in its mana requirements. Wastelands are also included to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

The main concept of this Grixis Aggro deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent using efficient creatures like Orcish Bowmasters, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Wasteland. Mishra's Bauble and Ponder help with card selection while Brainstorm provides card advantage. The overall strategy is to efficiently use resources to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent in order to secure a swift victory.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a combination of powerful creatures and disruptive spells to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents. The deck aims to maintain board control, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and generate advantage through card draw and selection. By efficiently using removal, counterspells, and powerful threats like Murktide Regent, the deck can navigate the game to its advantage and come out on top. The mana base is carefully constructed to provide the necessary colors and resources to support the deck's strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively play creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, Questing Beast, and Murktide Regent while disrupting opponents with counterspells like Daze, Force of Will, and Spell Pierce. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat while also digging for key cards with cantrips like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Mishra's Bauble. The mana base is designed to provide the necessary colors for the spells while also including utility lands like Wasteland to disrupt opponents' mana bases.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay, utilizing powerful creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent to pressure the opponent. It also includes disruptive spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect your board and disrupt your opponent's strategy. With cards like Mishra's Bauble and Brainstorm to draw cards and manipulate the top of your deck, you can maintain tempo and stay ahead of your opponent. Wasteland is included to disrupt your opponent's mana base, while Lightning Bolt provides direct damage and removal options. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's resources and board state with cards like Smallpox, Thoughtseize, and Liliana of the Veil. It utilizes control elements to maintain dominance on the battlefield, with support from cards like Ensnaring Bridge and Crucible of Worlds. The deck also features a strong land denial strategy with Wasteland and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth, while utilizing Karn, the Great Creator and Urza's Saga for additional utility and value. The deck aims to grind out the opponent's resources and win through attrition.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game by using a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while gradually building up resources and card advantage. By utilizing cards like Murktide Regent and Orcish Bowmasters to pressure the opponent's life total, while also having the ability to answer threats with cards like Murderous Cut and Fatal Push, this deck seeks to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of efficient removal spells, counterspells, and card draw to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By using cards like Brainstorm, Force of Will, and Daze to maintain card advantage and protect key threats like Murktide Regent and Leovold, Emissary of Trest, the deck aims to out-value the opponent and grind out a win. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Wasteland and Stifle also help to disrupt the opponent's mana base and key plays, giving the control player a strategic advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to use aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent to quickly apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also utilizes efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to maintain board control. The mana base is built around fetchlands and dual lands to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana. Overall, the goal is to maintain a fast-paced aggro strategy while also disrupting the opponent's plans.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt your opponent's game plan while aggressively pressuring them with efficient creatures. By using cards like Grief and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt their hand and graveyard, you can control the pace of the game. Murktide Regent and Troll of Khazad-dûm provide powerful threats that can quickly close out the game. The deck also utilizes counter magic like Force of Will and Daze, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Snuff Out, to keep the opponent on the back foot. Finally, the deck includes powerful card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure you have the tools you need to win.

The deck aims to disrupt opponents' mana bases by playing powerful hate cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon, while also quickly pressuring them with aggressive creature threats like Goblin Rabblemaster. The deck utilizes fast mana accelerants like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox to power out its threats quickly, aiming to close out the game before opponents can stabilize. The deck also utilizes cards like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere to further disrupt opponents' game plans, making it difficult for them to effectively cast spells.

This deck focuses on gaining a fast advantage by playing aggressive creatures like Archon of Emeria and using cards like Seasoned Dungeoneer and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to maintain card advantage. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's plans using cards like Chalice of the Void and Solitude while also ramping into powerful plays with cards like Chrome Mox and Lotus Petal. The deck utilizes efficient lands like Ancient Tomb and Cavern of Souls to further establish board presence and pressure. Overall, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

This deck focuses on using Ninjas and evasive creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent while disrupting their game plan with counter spells and removal. By playing cheap, efficient creatures like Changeling Outcast and Ornithopter, the deck is able to deploy threats early while also leveraging Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow's ability to manipulate the top of the deck for bonus damage. The deck also includes some powerful disruptive cards like Force of Will, Thoughtseize, and Daze to keep the opponent on the back foot, allowing the Ninjas to close out the game swiftly.

The deck focuses on assembling the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill opponents' decks. It uses cards like Goblin Engineer and Goblin Welder to search and recur combo pieces, while also including disruption like Pyroblast and Lightning Bolt to control the board. The deck aims to quickly set up the combo while using mana acceleration from cards like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb. Additionally, Urza's Saga provides additional utility and card advantage. Ultimately, the goal is to leverage the combo to win the game in a fast and efficient manner.
